package javazoo;

public class JavaZoo {

	   //Attribute
	private String zooName = "Java Park n Zoo";
	
	//Accessory
	 public String getZooName() {
		 return this.zooName;
	 }
	
	  //Main Method
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
	
	//Creating individual instances based on the instructions
		ZooAnimal myFirstAnimal = new ZooAnimal("Leo");
		Cage myFirstCage = new Cage (10, 5, 8);
		Zookeeper myFirstZookeeper = new Zookeeper ("John");
		JavaZoo myJavaZoo = new JavaZoo();
		
	//Setting additional sample attributes to demonstrate methods
		myFirstAnimal.setType("Lion");
		myFirstAnimal.setAge(5);
		myFirstAnimal.setHungry(true);
		
		myFirstCage.setClean(true);
		myFirstCage.setCovered(false);
		
		myFirstZookeeper.setTitle("Senior Keeper");
		myFirstZookeeper.setPayRate(23.50);
		myFirstZookeeper.setDegree(true);
		
		
	//Printing out all the values using accessory methods
		System.out.println("======ZOO INFORMATION======");
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("ZOO NAME: " + myJavaZoo.getZooName());
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("======ANIMAL INFORMATION======");
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("Animal Name: " + myFirstAnimal.getName());
		System.out.println("Animal Type: " + myFirstAnimal.getType());
		System.out.println("Animal Age: " + myFirstAnimal.getAge());
		System.out.println("Is Hungry? " + myFirstAnimal.isHungry());
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("Cage Dimensions (L x W x H): " + myFirstCage.getLenght() + " x " + myFirstCage.getWidth() + " x " + myFirstCage.getHeight());
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("Is Clean? " + myFirstCage.isClean());
		System.out.println("Is Covered? " + myFirstCage.isCovered());
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("======ZOOKEEPER INFORMATION======");
		System.out.println("            ");
		System.out.println("Zookeeper Name Is: " + myFirstZookeeper.getName());
		System.out.println("Zookeeper Title: " + myFirstZookeeper.getTitle());
		System.out.println("Pay Rate: $" + myFirstZookeeper.getPayRate());
		System.out.println("Has Degree? " + myFirstZookeeper.isDegree());

	}

}
